## Recommended materials

1. **[Grade 5 Grammar Exam — Kuraplan](https://www.kuraplan.com/au/worksheet/grade-5-grammar-exam-44419)**  
   **Use:** English grammar warm-up/quiz (printable PDF).  
   **Suitability confirmed:** The resource is explicitly labeled **Grade 5**, **Free**, and **Printable**. It covers familiar upper-elementary grammar practice—parts of speech, pronouns, verb tenses, prepositions, conjunctions, subjects and verbs, punctuation, and capitalization. The site says it is formatted for standard paper and intended for classroom, homework, tutoring, or homeschool use. Because the worksheet is longer than a short warm-up, use the opening parts-of-speech questions as the quiz portion. Note that Kuraplan indicates users sign up free to download the PDF.

2. **[Entrepreneurship Lesson Plans PDF — Biz Kids](https://bizkids.com/wp-content/uploads/BK-Entrepreneurship_Lesson-Plans-1.pdf)**  
   **Relevant activity/title:** **“The Marketing Mix” (Lesson 4)**.  
   **Use:** Print the Lesson 4 activity/pages for an introductory marketing exercise.  
   **Suitability confirmed:** Biz Kids identifies this lesson as teaching the four Ps—**product, price, place, and promotion**—and its lesson description says students create a marketing plan for a product or service. That makes it a direct fit for the requested basic four-Ps activity; the PDF is provided by the site as its downloadable lesson plans. Biz Kids frames its entrepreneurship materials for young learners, so the product/service-planning task should be accessible to an eighth-grade student with normal teacher guidance.

3. **[Smiley Face Theme for Education Presentation — Slidesgo](https://slidesgo.com/theme/smiley-face-theme-for-education)**  
   **Use:** One cheerful slide deck for both the grammar warm-up and the four-Ps activity.  
   **Suitability confirmed:** Slidesgo labels this a **free** education presentation template for **Google Slides or PowerPoint**. It is described as colorful, funny, and multi-purpose, with editable/customizable features for lesson presentations. Its education focus and flexible layout make it appropriate for a brief classroom lesson that moves from a quiz to a marketing task.
